about:
AMP Welding & Metal Fabrication is a privately owned welding and fabrication company founded in 2018 in Daphne, Alabama. The business was started by Alvon Portis, who brought over 20 years of experience in the commercial and residential building industries into a full‑time steel, aluminum, and metallurgical production operation. Today the shop manages projects across Alabama, Mississippi, and parts of Florida.

The company operates as a custom production metal shop, offering a wide range of welding processes — including MIG, TIG, stick, laser, orbital, flux‑core, and specialized techniques for stainless steel, cast iron, pipeline, and underwater applications — alongside fabrication services such as metal fabrication, stainless steel fabrication, industrial and heavy metal fabrication, staircase and handrail fabrication, plasma cutting, and powder coating. A core workforce of skilled engineers, operatives, and technicians handles projects from initial blueprints through final installation, though the facility size and exact headcount are not disclosed.

AMP serves commercial, residential, military, aerospace, medical, industrial, automotive, electronics, agricultural, and entertainment sectors. Its customer base includes businesses, homeowners, and clients seeking art projects or specialty designs, with the company emphasizing hands‑on collaboration from concept to completion.

The firm highlights its commitment to safety, timely delivery, innovative technology, customer‑focused solutions, long‑term durability, full project support, eco‑friendly practices, and transparent pricing as key differentiators. Portis’s artistic background is also noted as a driver for turning client concepts into finished metalwork.
